name: wan-2-2-t2v-a14b

wanVideo.architecture: Mixture-of-Experts (27B total, 14B active per step) — high-noise + low-noise experts

resources.videoSecondsTypical: ~120-300s per 5s clip on RTX 4090 with offload; ~60-150s on A100

notes: Wan 2.2 T2V-A14B — text-to-video only, MoE architecture with separate high-noise and low-noise experts (27B total parameters, 14B active per denoising step). Higher quality than the 5B variant, sharper detail and better prompt adherence, at the cost of ~3-5× longer inference. Apache 2.0. For image-to-video at this quality level, use wan-2-2-i2v-a14b (separate container, same runner code). For combined T+I2V with lower VRAM, use wan-2-2-ti2v-5b instead.
